english.note: Use this when something serves as a sign or testimony to an achievement or fact.
Use this when something serves as visible evidence or an illustration of another quality, as in the aqueducts being a testament to engineering skill.

examples.english: Winning this award is testimony to years of hard work.
examples.traditional: 佢攞到呢個獎，係多年努力嘅見證。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 lo2 dou3 ni1 go3 zoeng2 hai6 do1 nin4 nou5 lik6 ge3 gin3 zing3

examples.english: This ancient bridge is a testament to the craftsmen's superb skills.
examples.traditional: 呢座古橋係工匠精湛技術嘅見證。
examples.jyutping: ni1 zo6 gu2 kiu4 hai6 gung1 zoeng6 zing1 zaam3 gei6 seot6 ge3 gin3 zing3
